subject: Disconnected from Server, no memory issue, code works fine locally, error in xhr_streaming

messages.author: f47af873d6da1dbc
messages.subject: Disconnected from Server, no memory issue, code works fine locally, error in xhr_streaming
parts:
Hi,

I have seen quite a few posts on this subject, yet none exactly matched what I am seeing so here we go:

We've developed this app to query network data on from Amazon. It runs smoothly on our laptops but crashes and displays the message <Disconnected from the server> two seconds after the start. I checked the memory usage in the shinyapps.io dashboard but it never even reached 800MB... The server logs (btw is there an option to get more detailed stack traces? the tutorials on the shiny website didn't really do the trick for us) show nothing (see log below). However I do see an error when I look at my browser console at xhr_streaming:

curl "https://nda1.shinyapps.io/nda1/__sockjs__/n=zSmytSehjEZS4GWwkp/t=51b875909d0eda4d6c144935c23eea10/w=ab178cf5/s=0/330/ij6p90q3/xhr_streaming" -X POST -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/56.0.2924.87 Safari/537.36" -H "Referer: https://nda1.shinyapps.io/nda1/" -H "Origin: https://nda1.shinyapps.io" --compressed

Could this be an indicator for one of you? Or is this just the error because of the cut connection by the server? Earlier I also saw a browser-console issue with shinythemes which I then removed which in turn made the error disappear. Does anyone have an idea of where else I could look / what else I could do? 
Thanks much,

jonathan
